review_description: Great service and attention to details.Jen is very lovely and helpful.She provided supported throughout the process very nicely.Rob and his team of installers were very attentive to details and left an impression of people who actually care about what they do, which is very rare these days.No hidden fees and Rob has helped me with few other little things, which I really appreciate.I'm very impressed and happy to recommend this company to anyone.

We’re very pleased with the recent upgrade to our solar system, which included a new hybrid inverter, a16kW battery pack and additional panels.The SolarEze team was professional and a pleasure to work with. Rob and his crew did an outstanding job on the installation, going above and beyond to quickly resolve a technical issue.I’ve recommended SolarEze before and will continue to do so for solar installations and support.Thank you Rob, Jen, and the entire team, we appreciate all you have done for us!
Rob and crew did a fantastic job, very tidy, very Professional I would highly recommend.

We used Lindsy and Rob from Solareze on our last house, and we've recommended them to our friends and neighbours have used them too. Working with Lindy and Rob was easy. Rob was very keen to make the installation as clean and tidy as possible. They did all the work for the discounts from certificates. Quality install and finish. I'll be recommending them to other neighbours and friends wanting solar and batteries.
Great communication. Listened and provided a second quote. Waited until my preferred battery became available and installed 28 panels and a battery in a morning. Magic crew :-)

From the moment we contacted Solar Eze the team was wanting to make the transition to solar easy. Jen phoned to explain rvery aspect of the system. No question was too stupid.We wanted the roof cleaned before the solar went in. Rob arranged someone to do that and scheduled it to suit. The old system was removed free of charge ( others wanted to charge $300 + for that). The installation was so quick!And there was after sales service - unheard of these days! The lovely Jen called to make sure we understood what was happening and to help us navigate the different plans. She helped us work out the best option.Solar Eze really did make it solar easy for us. We would like to give them six stars ??????
Reasonable quote.Very professional approach.Very detailed explanation.Installation process was awesome.

From the very first email with Jennifer and from my first encounter with Rob and his team, everything was done completely professional and smoothly! Whenever I had any questions or concerns, Jennifer was able to clarify for me and made the entire process easy to follow along. I would recommend SolarEZE to anyone looking to install solar panels.Also, upon seeing other positive reviews about Finn, I decided to contact him myself as it was my first time buying solar panels for my home. Upon contacting Finn, he provided me with so much assistance and guidance on what I should be looking for when it comes to great quality solar panels that are value for my money. I would suggest anyone looking to buy solar panels to seek out Finn for his expert advice.

I had obtained a number of quotations independently and through SolarQuotes. I had around 4 to choose from and compared system sizes and $'s.  in my view SolarEze were not the lowest price but offered the best value for money considering the brands they offered.  I also met with each rep in person and by far the most important aspect.  Lindy representing SolarEze was by fantastic.  Accommodating a late evening home visit, providing direct, honest and clear advice and providing a level of professionalism without being 'salesy'.  Lindy knew her stuff.  The installation timing and crew were also professional, punctual and no-nonsense.  The installation was very tidy.  A great all-round experience and no hesitation in recommending SolarEze.

We recently had a 10kW Sigenergy inverter with 24kWh batteries and 13.3kW Aiko Neostar 2P panels installed by SolarEze and we couldn’t be happier with the entire process.From the start Jen (SolarEze sales consultant) was extremely patient and helpful taking the time to walk us through multiple system configurations and product options until we found the perfect fit.On installation day Rob and his team were professional, respectful of our property and did a fantastic job. The workmanship was excellent—cabling and conduit were neatly hidden, all penetrations were sealed properly and the overall finish was very tidy.The system has been operating exactly as promised and we are already seeing the benefits. We highly recommend SolarEze for anyone considering solar and battery storage.
The quote was handled smartly and returned within 48 hours.Tradesmen were professional and tidy .All the functions of the inverter and meter board explained.

From the very beginning, my experience with this company was excellent. Their consultant Jan was incredibly helpful, taking the time to answer all of my questions thoroughly and fill in the gaps in my knowledge. She managed my expectations realistically and provided clarity on how the system would work for both my current and future electricity needs. After carefully reviewing my electricity bill and listening to my requirements, she presented me with five tailored quote options, which gave me the confidence to make an informed decision.When it came to installation, Rob and his teammate demonstrated an outstanding level of professionalism and attention to detail. They were so pedantic and meticulous in their work that I have no doubt every aspect of the installation was completed to the highest standard. Even old antenna holes were carefully sealed and isolated, leaving me with peace of mind that nothing was overlooked.Overall, the entire process—from consultation to installation—was seamless, transparent, and reassuring. I would not hesitate to recommend this team to anyone considering solar panels and battery solutions.

This installation was a result of existing system beginning to fail and investigating possible options to repair / replace. The old system had more that paid for itself so all options were considered.Jen made the whole quote process very easy and was able to answer all my questions. Discussed several options before settling on the installation. The quote was very competitive with others installers (was lowest).Rob and guys arrived at the agreed time and date and were straight into the job - this was a complete strip down of the old system and installation of a new. They even took the time to remove all the old satellite dishes from years past.Had the whole job completed before lunch time - all rubbished removed and property left clean.This was the second installation that I have been involved in with this company and have been very happy both times - would recommend / use again.

So impressed with SolarEZE. Down to earth company, gave me the real facts and gave me time and space to consider quotes. I never felt pressured or hassled. Installation was quick and easy. The app was up and running that day, and super easy to use. I will recommend this team to everyone!

We wanted a solar system + battery, got 4 quotes from local solar installers based on their reviews on SolarQuotes.SolarEze had excellent reviews, good products and fair prices, and Jen was a pleasure to deal with - nice to talk to, didn't try to "sell" us anything, answered all our questions, was happy to give us different quotes until we could decide what size system we wanted, and got the job organised promptly. We went for a 13kw system with a 19kw battery.Rob and his co-worker did the whole installation in one morning (starting early :). Friendly and efficient, not a straightforward job considering the need to place the battery on the separate garage wall rather than the main house. And he helped us connect to the app in the end.Jen is here to help with any questions post-installation.I don't usually leave reviews, but these guys are definitely warmly recommended!

I had read many reviews on solarquotes.com.au & did a lot of reading about getting solar installed. When you are starting with no knowledge you really need to do this I believe.We chose SolarEZE for a few reasons. Their reviews were excellent, their quote wasn't the most expensive nor the least expensive & Jen answered my many questions.We also weren't sold any 'deals', one company said if we wanted to get our costs lower they might have excess panels from a cancelled job. After checking reviews this was part of their sales tactic.Our installation was staged over 2 seperate weeks, firstly we had the brackets installed, then our roof was repointed & repainted and then a week or 2 later the solar installation was completed. This flexibility was really necessary & most appreciated.Rob & his installation team were professional, on time & made sure we knew how to use the app.We got an electricity bill within a few weeks of installation so I haven't been able to compare pre & post costs yet. And I also haven't changed to a different provider, yet. They have increased our electricity rate since we got solar. Will be looking at those options after we receive our next electricity bill.We would highly recommend SolarEZE.Make sure to get a few quotes & ask as many questions as necessary. It's a big cost item & you should feel you are spending the money wisely. And read the reviews, they all help!

I had my old solar system replaced and upgraded with a battery.I want to thank Jen and Rob for their patience while I sorted out which provider and what system I was going to go with. It took me several months to decide, but in the end I feel that i made the right choices.On the day of the installation, Rob and his team arrived early and didn't waste any time assessing what needed to be done and got to work in removing the old system.  I want to thank Rob and his team for their patience while some roofers had to finish of some work and seemed to be able to work around them before installing the final panels.Overall the job was done very professionally and fast.  The explanation of the system monitoring through the APP was handled well and left little for me to question.Once again thanks to Rob and his team and I can highly recommend them.

Rob, Jen and team were fantastic right from the start. Easily the best communication, price and information of all the companies I contacted. Rob and the boys did a fantastic job installing the battery and walking us through the app functionality. Will be recommending them to family and friends. Greatly appreciated.

I have nothing but praise for Solareze, from the time of the initial quote, the onsite quote, the install everything has been done on a professional level and well priced. I had many changes and questions to ask throughout the process and all were responded to in a timely manner.There was no push, sales just gave me all the info I needed to make my own decision.Thanks Rob and Lindy.Would definitely recommend.
Well planned neat installation with good communication and an easy transition
Fantastic quoting, pre purchase advice and communication. Efficient install with no issues.

We were extremely happy with the initial quote from Jen, and the follow up emails to get the size of the system right for us.Rob and his crew did a fantastic job from start to finish. Also any Questions were answered including adding a battery to the system at a later time. I would not hesitate to recommend Rob and his company to anyone thinking of adding solar to their home .Just great people to deal with.

-Jen sales and quoting was 100% a valued service-Rob (owner / installer): On time, clean and tidy, explained all aspects of the system and battery, organised all rebates and grid connection. Excellent job.

Very happy i went with SolarEze. They were great to deal with, no questions was too much and their pricing was excellent too. The install went perfectly, they were in and out in a few hours, leaving no mess and helped me setup the app. I had several quotes, SolarEze was the most transparent and most competitive pricing. Definitely recommend these guys.

After a few attempts of gathering information together over the past 12 months and getting frustrated that I was constantly being told that this system is the best because of "insert marketing pitch here", I was so pleasantly refreshed by Jen at SolarEZE. After a 10 minutes conversation, she understood what I was after and sent me through a quote, no sales pitch, no we are better because everyone else is not up to standard, just a willingness to put up a great product at a decent price and stand by what they were offering. A quick follow up call once the quote arrived to clarify a couple of questions and we moved forward with a date in a couple of week for install.On the day of install, Rob and the team was onsite and ready to go at 7am, and had installed 20kw by 10:30am. They also made sure they had collected every last piece of rubbish around the house, leaving no sign they had been there other than a shiny new system on the roof.Would absolutely recommend for your solar install... Thanks Guys!
Was very prompt and efficient. After a few others we decided on SolarEZE, communication was great.

Jen was fantastic to deal with, the best Customer Service I have experienced for a long time.Trust me I am a consumer monkey, andIi do not have a single negative thing to say regarding my interactions with the company.Rob and his installation team were friendly and efficient and the installation was extremely tidy.All in all a super experience, which in this day and age, is hard to come by.Regards and good luck.

I was really impressed with the entire process dealing with SolarEZE. Jen was fantastic to work with through the quoting process, answering questions and being flexible with install as I was getting a roof restoration done at the same time. No high pressure sales techniques, just good open communication to ensure I got what I wanted.Nothing was too much trouble for the team, and Rob and his team were fantastic regarding the installation, as they were quick, tidy, and efficient and walked me through what they were doing and were more than happy to answer any questions that I had.I was further impressed that I received a follow up call after to ensure that I was happy and that all my questions had been answered.
Solareze were responsive and easy to deal with from start to finish.  The installation was seamless, on time, neat, clean and professional I highly recommend solareze
Our thanks to Rob at Solar Eze for his service amd quality install. I'm very happy with all aspects from communicatin to install to products used to ease of use.A worthy 5 star from me.
Jen was fantastic to deal with throughout the entire process and was responsive and informative. Rob and his team were professional with the install at our commercial premises.

I recently had the pleasure of having Solar installed with Solar Eze, and I couldn't be happier with the experience. Jen's communication was on point throughout the entire process, keeping me informed and answering all my questions promptly. Rob, the installer, was amazing—professional, efficient, and meticulous. The installation went smoothly, and the system is working perfectly. Highly recommend Solar Eze for their exceptional service and expertise!
Quote process was quick and all questions were answered and explained.Install was on time efficient.
Lindy was excellent at providing information on how the solar worked and what we could expect from it. Rob & crew arrived early and were finished quickly. Would definitely recommend.

Jen the salesperson was very knowledgeable. Great to speak to and answer my questions. And Rob the owner of the business was great, super friendly and great having a local install my solar. Great service and was working the same day it was installed.

We accepted the quote from SolarEZE because of the helpful and friendly advice from the salesperson.The salesperson was Lindy, who went out of her way to offer advice and answer questions without hesitation each time I contacted her.Rob, the owner/electrician/installer at SolarEZE, completed the installation with two offsiders.The installation was done professionally, neatly and on time. The new inverter was installed inside our garage whereas the previous one for the system this installation replaced no doubt failed as it was installed on a hot outside wall.Once installed Rob showed me how to set up the App for monitoring the system through the Sungrow S100 Smart Meter which was included. It's great to be able to see at any time of the day or night how your power is operating either from the grid or panels.As we had an existing system, we didn't need a grid connection as we were already sending power to the grid.

Had solareze supply/install panels and a bluetti ep760 which i supplied.  This was a first for them and I struggled with other installers getting qoutes because of the bluetti, not an issue for solareze.Solareze were incredibly easy to deal with, easy to get in contact with and didn't mind all the revisions I did as I got my head around the bluetti requirements.Install team were fast, tidy and professional.From a guy who does his research and is pretty particular, I would definitely recommend them.

Jen from Solar EZE was very patient, informative and willing to answer all of our questions when providing a quote.As a result, there were no surprises when Rob and his team arrived to install.The installation was seamless, professional, efficient and looks great. Rob and his team were friendly, efficient and ensured nothing was left behind after installation.Rob helped set up the app used to monitor the system and Jen followed up to ensure everything was working and check on any queries we may have.The price also included adding a hot water timer.

The team at SolarEZE deserve 5 stars.Please note that I have only given four stars for the quality of the system and value for money as we only had the system installed a week ago, so have not been able to make an informed decision yet.  However, the specs look good at this stage and the system is pumping out the KWs.  I particularly like the phone app.Back to SolarEZE. Lindy at the office explained everything in detail and provided all that information on paper. Rob and the team were efficient, professional and friendly. Rob explained everything after the system was installed.We went for a large number of panels and a 12 WK battery system. There are only two of us and in Sep we are producing around 50+KW per day and only using around 12 KW. The remainder goes into the battery (of which we use around 5KW each night) and the rest feeds into the grid for a small feed in tariff.  Can't wait for summer when the production increases and we can run a/c without the big bills.I highly recommend checking out SolarEZE if you are looking for a panel (and battery) system.

Jen helped with everything from the quote and the size of the system, as well as helping with any body corp issues.Installation was completed within a week and up and running the same day.Connected everything the same day. Very tidy and good communication throughout.Price was mid range to other quotes but happy I went with these guys for their customer service.

Quoting process was easy. Jen from their sales team was really patient and answered all my questions.Rob and his team arrived early and ahead of schedule. Installation crew were super fast, power was only out for less than 30 minutes and the team was done and cleaning up by 11am for our huge 20kw system.We didn't have WiFi setup by installation day so hopefully we can do that over the phone but Rob has offered to come back and set that up if can't manage it myself.Will update if we have any issues but really happy with Solar Eze and would recommend them to anyone looking for Solar.

The quoting process was easy, Jen was easy to talk to about the details and the quote I got was great for what I was looking for.Following this, installation day rolled around and the guys smashed it out quickly and cleanly - offering to go above and beyond to make sure I was happy.Following this, I've had no issues whatsoever, and can easily monitor the system myself.
We received good responses and advice from all 3 installers.  In the end it came down to price and the installer we chose was punctual, capable and  provided a professional service.

Rob, Jen and the team  at SolarEze made the task of installing my system a breeze. From the quoting through to installation the process was seamless and the quality of the workmanship impeccable.I am so glad I took the plunge and can thoroughly recommend SolarEze to anybody.And the system is delivering big time!

Lindy is knowledgeable and professional and spoke in terms that we could understand.  She took into account our individual needs and provided a highly competitive quote.  Rob and his team were professional and efficient in decommissioning the old system, installing the new system and linking it to the grid.  The system was operational on day of install.  We also had bird proofing installed.  The team were friendly and respectful and were clean and tidy.  Highly recommend SolarEZE.

Lindy has great knowledge and excellent advice about solar systems to suit individual needs, the type of panels and the electricity supply companies to ensure you get the best financial outcomes and system usage. Rob and his team of installers were efficient, neat and tidy and there were no hassles with the installation.We debated having solar panels installed for many months and I wish we would have done it sooner.  The whole process was easy and seamless and any questions or concerns we had or still have are followed up and answered. We highly recommend SolarEZE.

Starting from Jen who was awesome throughout the sales/design process and Rob is a leader who is doing an awesome job with his team. Gets his hands dirty to make sure things are installed correctly and the boys were also great. Did a very neat and clean job. They were very reasonably priced compared to the online solar scammers who outsource their installations.

We are really happy with the solar solution that SolarEze installed, as well as their service right from the initial discussion with the sales person (thanks Lindy!) to the installation of the system. We had a few false starts with installation - wet weather on two occasions, having to remove old (non-working) solar panels and a large old (non-working) solar hot water system, major roof repairs (partial replacement); none of these were because of the installer, but they agreeably worked in with us through a fairly drawn out process for a great final result. Thanks Rob!

As an engineer I research everything to death. Committing to have solar installed was only going to happen when I was 100% satisfied with all the answers. The customer service of the Solareze team with Jen as the first point of contact was incredible. Jen was happy to keep answering more and more questions via phone calls and emails and had good answers for everything that I needed to know. Never once was I asked to put down a deposit to be locked in. On installation day, Rob and his team were excellent too, all working together to provide a neat, tidy and good looking installation of panels and inverter with no visible cables or conduiting. I had a few optional extras installed: hot water timer and pigeon proofing. I highly recommend Solareze.

Getting a quote from SolarEZE was easy. The salesperson provided lots of information and was happy to discuss a range of options. The installation was quick and on time. Customer service has been exceptional and the app very easy to comprehend. The price was very competitive and they even rang around to find a great price on a scissor lift (necessary for installation) to save us money. Very impressive.

Lindy from Solareze had a lot of knowledge and was able to communicate it to me in layman's terms so I felt that I understood how to choose the appropriate system to meet my requirements. Robs installation was to the level I would have expected when spending thousands of dollars on a system. He and his team were efficient and cleaned up etc. The system was commissioned immediately and Rob called energex to notify them for the process of feed in to commence. He also set up the monitoring account. All aspects of the sales and installation process went very well.

Great process by supplier. Heaps of info to make decision.  Process support was very good and once selected their follow up to install date was quick and installed on the day nominated. Price was good for product and follow up was helpful to get active on new solar system. Great to deal with.

From first conatct the supplier process has been excellent with the information. Not only helping with the start time of installation but with future savings on how the new system can save money. Offering advice on eacjh contact call. Great support on the line.

Sales quoting by Jen was professional personal no nonsense and very polite, all questions i had were answered promptly and correctly with speed. The installation went without any hick ups and the boys were more friend than workers, but they went about the job with great care. After the install Rob set my phone up so i could see what my unit was doing when ever i wanted i am hopeless with tecky stuff but Rob did it and did not make me feel stupid. My system that i had replaced was only 5 years old but the owner  of the company had changed hands several times so no help there, i got a company around to see what my problems were $180 cash later no help at all  very upsetting for a pensioner, i firmly believe that my new installer will not let me down.

The Sales consultant sat down with us and actually worked out the best size solar and battery to suit our energy usage. Other companies just turned up and asked what we wanted.It was great to deal with the Owner of the company who did the install for us, not just the install team we get allocated.Always happy to go with a small company that does an amazing job and has great customer service

When Jen came over to discuss a quote, she got out a sheet of paper and asked me a ton of questions about energy use, appliances, power costs and did the math right in front of us for multiple scenarios. She took the time to discuss different brands, and answered my many follow up questions. They weren't the cheapest, but I could tell they really stood behind what the did and I trusted them with my installation. They did not disappoint. Nearly 6 months on and the system is working great!

I'd contacted 6 Solar Installers & didn't feel at all comfortable, our neighbour suggested I talk with Solareze, I'd noticed them when checking Solar Quotes.Within a minute of talking with Jen I knew we were on to the right people, Jen is beyond Customer Service, her knowledge (via her questions of our system that needed replacing) is amazing, she knows her job.Rob' & his installation team arrived early today, yoohoo, replaced 22 panels with 14 new ones, plus of course it was a totally new System. Rob' & his team left us a few hours later feeling absolutely confident & that we'd made the right choice with the whole process as smooth as.Customer Service? Jen rang this arvo to check if we were happy, had any questions, etc etc, how good is that?Thank you big time Solareze, we have already provided another neighbour with your business card.
No problems, they were very prompt answering all my questions. Installed when they said they would. Cannot fault them at all
The solareze process was good from start to finish, with Jen helping us decide which one was best for us, to Rob and his team installing like a well oiled machine.

Had a very good experience with SolarEZE. The sales consultant was very professional and extremely helpful throughout the whole process. Come installation time Rob and his crew were on time and done a very precise, clean and complete install. He helped me set up the app and get it running. Would definitely recommend Rob and SolarEZE
Fantastic service and install. Good communication. No issues. Working perfectly. Cannot comment on reliability, only installed today.

I had three quotes for the same inverter system and Solareze came in cheaper than the other two (even with slightly more reputable panels). I was a little worried initially as they were the only installer to not make a site inspection at point of quote and we are on a 2 storey Queenslander with a reasonably sheer roof. I called and spoke with Jen and was reassured that everything was in order.To be honest, the decider for me was working with Jen. She took the time not to just sell me the system I said I wanted, but to work through options with me thoroughly, even analysing my current power provider plan and working through potential savings with other providers to go for a better deal. In the end, by the time it came to installation I felt well informed and confident not just in the company installing but in my understanding of my system, my decision on the system type and size, but also in my energy bill!I had a smaller old system already installed and decided to have to removed and disposed of at the same time. This was included in the quote at no additional cost.Rob and the fellas arrived when they said they would and worked quickly on a hot day to strip off the old system and replace it with the new, all in about 4 hours. Rob made sure to walk me through any decisions that were needed, as well as the app. A quick, thorough job, including a thorough cleanup at the end!All in all the experience has been great and I will be looking at working with them again directly in the future if I hop off the fence and get a battery.

It perhaps would have been better had the site been inspected prior to the installation (only one of the quoting companies offered this and even they ended up getting the information over the phone from me).  As it was, the installation was deleyed by a week as the roof material required special items for mounting.  Having said that the installers removed the old 1kW system, a wasps nest and the disconnected solar HWS for no additional cost.  Apart from the delay I was very happy with the whole process.
Excellent customer service! Prompt and efficient dealings and system was installed in no time with no mess :)

I went through solar quotes to obtain quotes for installing a suitable system for our needs. Solareze was one of the three recommended to me.From the moment they answered the call to provide a quote, I spoke with Jen, I could tell straight away that Solareze didn't see customers the same way that others did and I felt very comfortable. Jen went through all our needs, usage and previous bills and advised of a suitable system that would fulfill our requirements. There was no hard sales pitch, straight to the point and best of all asked us a lot of questions we didn't think about as well as answered ours. A plan of the set out of the panels was sent in the quote and was subject to approval of Rob who would do the install. We have a shady part on the roof and this was taken into account and panels were not placed there.Installation day was a breeze. The guys were right on time, professional and everything was explained and assurance given should anything go wrong, on completion Rob set up the app on phone, explained how to use it and left the place clean and tidy.I highly recommend Rob, Jen and his team at Solareze,
Really please with service and install - all working fine and very seamless.

I initially was contracted to another company and SolarEze staff were very patient and not pushy while I was cancelling this other contract.  Quotes were clear and personalised and they were more than happy to provide multiple quotes to cover different options I was considering.
From the moment we were engaged by the sales team, to the final sign off for install, we were treated with respected and as a priority. The work was clean and site left the way it was found.
Quoting was simple and easy.Install day went well, turned up on time and they did a clean and tidy install. Rob was super polite and answered any questions I had.System has been preforming well.

6 November 2023Today, panels and inverter installed. Inverter then removed for interior painting and secure lock up. Quick, clean, tidy, efficient, and good communication.Installation commenced on site. New house nearing lock up stage.28 x Jinko Neo N-Type 475W panelsKlip-Lok racking2 x Hot water timersSungrow 10 kW premium 3 phase Hybrid inverterSungrow 9.6 kW BatteryConsumption meter/monitoring (access to iSolarcloud app.)

Jen was fabulous to deal with.  Prompt and answered all questions in detail and with qualifying information. Install was simple and no fuss and follow up questions also maintained being responsive and detailed.  Much appreciated.

I recently purchased a house and started getting quotes before settlement so access was limited. I got a call from Jen very soon after requesting three quotes from SolarQuotes. She listened to my needs and quickly provided a quote with a couple of options. She also mapped out the solar panels with GPS images to avoid shade from trees on the north end of the house (unlike some installers who planned to use the whole roof, which would result in poor performance over winter). SolarEZE was not the cheapest but had a very good price on a mid-range system and really seemed to know what they were doing. I booked in for about five weeks later but they were able to bring installation forward by two weeks when someone cancelled. On the day, Rob and his team showed up at 6:30 am and were finished by about 11! I was impressed by how efficiently they worked and how clean they left the place. The installation looks great and is working perfectly so far.
Very pleased with our solar installation.This is an honest, hassle free and down to earth family business without the unrealistic promises of others.Thanks Again.

The quoting process was easy and the installation went really smoothly. The people were great (both the sales and installers). Polite, helpful and efficient.They were also willing to help with after sales services like connection to the grid and rang to check everything was working through the tracking app and to help me interpret the data.Price was great.Really good overall experience.

Lindy was easily the best of our four options for the sales side. Installation was quick and tidy, Rob and crew did a great job. Solar has been operating perfectly since install, good gains to be had. Was a bit hard to get in contact with admin due to conflict with rostering, but resolved nevertheless.

Jen was particularly helpful during the quotation and was able to provide all necessary information for us to make an informed decision on the size and configuration of a suitable system to meet our needs.Rob and his team arrived at 7:00 am on the appointed day and had the system completely installed and feeding power to the house and battery by 11:30 am.At all stages of the installation Rob and his guys were friendly, polite and able to answer any queries that we had. The system included a timer for the hot water circuit to ensure that the thermostat could only connect the water heater when the solar system was generating adequate power to avoid the load being on the battery during the night. But it appears that the original electrician who wired up the house had mislabelled circuit breakers in the switchboard, so the timer was actually connected to our electric oven which would not operate in the early morning or evening.Rob arranged for this to fixed on a separate trip by one of his electricians at no addition cost.We are very pleased that we chose SolarEZE  to install our system

We could not be happier with our SolarEZE solar system. From the first consult with Jen, who was very knowledgable and happy to answer any questions, to the prompt and quality installation of the system by Rob and his crew. I would highly recommend SolarEZE to those looking for a fast, efficient and quality install.
From the initial discussion through to the end of the install, the service and communication were fantastic. Can't recommend Solar Eze highly enough.

Right from the start solareze was great may first contact with Jen one of the sales team was nice and relaxed she had all the answers to my questions and gave me some different options.Rob and his team where great all very friendly and professional no muching about they got straight into the job everybody knew their jobI highly recommend Rob and the whole solareze team

From beginning to end, SolarEZE were professional, provided an extraordinary service which was both personalised,  accommodating, professional and quality products. I was impressed with the quality of service in the time they took to educate me on how to think about what type and size of solar system to match our needs as a family. Their advice was thorough and they didn't drop the ball on any changes I needed made to the quote. Their flexibility with timing was also impressive. We were quoted approximately 8 months prior to installation and the price did not change. They pointed me to financiers that I could use because I needed a loan for our system.
